channel.title: nozzle
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.description:
• Sync version to 3.0.0
  • Update appcast.xml for version 3.0.0
  • Fix appcast.xml update script multiline handling
  • Use macos-26 runner for Xcode 26 compatibility
  • Make FoundationModels import conditional for CI compatibility
  • Use unsigned build for GitHub releases temporarily
  • Add Sparkle auto-updates and GitHub release workflow
  • Simplify onboarding and update README
  • Replace shortcuts placeholder with actual screenshot image
  • Add undo support for clear and rename operations

• Add Screenshot capture and multi-source content management
  • Add Sparkle auto-updates and GitHub release workflow
  • Simplify onboarding flow
  • Add undo support for clear and rename operations

• Added Belarusian translation.
  • Added separator line between pinned and unpinned items.
  • Added scrolling support for large texts in preview popover.
  • Added preview for HEIC image files.
  • Improved performance for large text copies.
  • Improved handling of hovered items.
  • Fixed paste + paste without formatting combination.
  • Fixed issue when file URLs were removed when pasting without formatting.
  • Fixed the issue when the first pinned item was not pre-selected and there were no unpinned items.
